Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $0.63 per share.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
Our cloud segment grew 24% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 167 basis points to 40.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 167 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
